audit.why: Kled contesting level 1 and levels 4-6 with Akali owning 2-3 and both item windows matches 40.48% Emerald+ over 589 games and the disk chart. Chart untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes listed 'Beartrap on a Rope online' as his spike and phases[4] ignored his ultimate entirely.
audit.why: His real spikes are the Q yank coming online, the dismount/remount health reset, and Chaaaaaaaarge!!! which grants a shield that eats your burst window.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes and phases[4].why now name the remount reset and the R shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: The ability was spelled 'Beartrap on a Rope' in nine places, and Violent Tendencies was never named.
audit.why: Riot's name is Bear Trap on a Rope. Violent Tendencies is an auto-attack reset granting massive attack speed for four attacks - the wind-up, not the cast, is the tell that a trade is starting.
audit.corrected: Every occurrence renamed; dontsFull[2].d now states the auto-reset tell and breakdown.cooldowns carries it.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Beartrap on a Rope' carried no number.
audit.why: Bear Trap on a Rope is 11/10/9/8/7 - an 11 second window at rank 1 is the whole reason to shroud-dodge it rather than walk away.
audit.corrected: tldr, winCon, breakdown.early/mid/cooldowns/trading, phases[1]/[3]/[5].why and dosFull now carry 11s.

edits.before: Shroud his pull — Q-poke, R-execute dismount. Akali wins the Beartrap on a Rope cooldown windows.
edits.after: Shroud his Bear Trap — Q-poke, R-execute dismount. Akali wins the Bear Trap cooldown windows.

edits.before: Shroud his pull and poke him down. Track Beartrap on a Rope before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Shroud his Bear Trap and poke him down. Track Bear Trap on a Rope's 11s at rank 1 before every commit.

edits.before: Kled wins by landing Beartrap on a Rope, denying your pattern, and out-trading your engage windows.
edits.after: Kled wins by landing Bear Trap on a Rope, yanking you in, and out-DPSing you with Violent Tendencies.

edits.before: Q Kled at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Step up once Bear Trap on a Rope is on its 11s, E-dash the angle, and shroud his Violent Tendencies.

edits.before: Q-poke on energy rhythm wins the chip war. Respect Kled's Beartrap on a Rope completely — the first levels are about banking small advantages, not proving a point.
edits.after: Q-poke on energy rhythm wins the chip war. Bear Trap on a Rope is 11s at rank 1 and the yank only lands if you stand still — chip him and step out of the line.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Beartrap on a Rope: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.
edits.after: Trade strictly around Bear Trap on a Rope's 11s: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.

edits.before: - Kled Beartrap on a Rope: matchup-defining — His engage hook. Shroud-dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope: matchup-defining — 11s at rank 1. Shroud-dodge the yank and he has no engage. - Violent Tendencies is an auto reset: the wind-up is your cue to step back. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Good trade: Q Kled at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire. Great trade: Kled wastes Beartrap on a Rope — commit the full pattern immediately. Bad trade: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Good trade: step up once Bear Trap on a Rope is on its 11s, E-dash the angle, and shroud his Violent Tendencies. Great trade: Kled whiffs the Bear Trap — commit the full pattern immediately. Bad trade: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.

edits.before: Kled: Beartrap on a Rope online, level 6, first item. Akali: levels 2-3 (full pattern), Lich Bane first-item spike, and the 2-item window.
edits.after: Kled: Bear Trap on a Rope online, the remount health reset, first item. Akali: levels 2-3 (full pattern), Lich Bane spike, and the 2-item window.

edits.before: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Only take the trade when Kled's Beartrap on a Rope is down.
edits.after: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Only step up while Bear Trap on a Rope's 11s is burning.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Beartrap on a Rope's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The lane-control window: trade on Bear Trap on a Rope's 11s cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.

edits.before: Both R casts turn survived all-ins into executes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kled's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Both R casts turn survived all-ins into executes. But Chaaaaaaaarge!!! shields him, so force that out of him first.

edits.before: Lich Bane is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Beartrap on a Rope's cooldown.
edits.after: Lich Bane is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Bear Trap on a Rope's 11s.

edits.before: Track Kled's Beartrap on a Rope before you commit
edits.after: Track Kled's Bear Trap on a Rope before you commit

edits.before: His engage hook. Shroud-dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 11s at rank 1. Shroud-dodge the yank; without it he has no engage.

edits.before: Q Kled at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Step up once Bear Trap on a Rope is on its 11s, E-dash the angle, and shroud his Violent Tendencies.

edits.before: Kled wastes Beartrap on a Rope — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Kled whiffs his Bear Trap on a Rope — commit the full pattern now.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: A refilled Skaarl bar is a second health pool your burst must chew.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Violent Tendencies opens with an auto reset — the wind-up, not the cast, is your cue to step back.

notes: 'Beartrap on a Rope' was the spelling used throughout; Riot's name is Bear Trap on a Rope. Content layer already used the correct name and was left alone. Kled's Chaaaaaaaarge!!! grants a shield that absorbs your burst window - previously unmentioned, now in phases[4].why.
